crossRefs.note: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
translations.bsb: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses had directed.
translations.kjv: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
translations.asv: So they drew near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.
